GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 6, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Vice Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Robert Meliere, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Donna Barrett, Member  Angie Young, Member
Larry Conkings, Member

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO LILIA.ROMERO@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-53554-01 Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Golf Advisory Committee Meeting
  held on Thursday, March 21, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-53555-01 Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-53556-01 Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-53557-01 Recommendation to receive and file the Subcommittee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  24-53558-01 Recommendation to review and approve the Golf Advisory Committee 2023 Annual
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 6.  24-53559-01 Recommendation to recommend the Director approve the requested American Golf
  Corporation food and beverage rates for 2024-2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 6, 2024
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

7.  24-53560-01 Recommendation to approve the Golf Advisory Committee meeting dates for the
  remainder of 2024 and adjust future regular meeting dates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia E. Romero, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia E. Romero at (562) 570-3104.
